# MUS-W-0007

<!-- Generated by `mustur export`. Do not hand-edit: `mustur verify` fails on drift, and the store is the record. -->

**StrucGu's check vocabulary, implemented**

work-unit · 2026-08-20

Discharges: [MUS-M-0003](../milestones.md#mus-m-0003)

## Context

The seven kinds and the five states, read from a module catalog and an adoption record.

## Depends on

MUS-M-0002's records, which are what it audits.

## Discharges

Part of MUS-M-0003: checking Mustur's own records against StrucGu's check vocabulary.

## Done means

All seven kinds are implemented and all five states distinguished, asserted by a test per kind with a tree that satisfies it and a mutation that trips it.\nA role whose module is not adopted makes a check bound to it skip rather than fail.\nAn adoption record missing a field a check requires is a run that cannot start, not a finding.\nThe audited tree is not written to.\nAn independent implementation of the same specification returns the same verdicts over this repository.

## Risks

The specification has no reference implementation, deliberately, so every reading could be the other one. Four are named in comments; the ones nobody noticed are the residual risk.\nA review comparing this against the independent implementation on eighteen trees the fixtures do not cover found four defects the fixtures had not. That is the measure of how much of the space fixtures pin, and of how much they do not.
